koi_period.name: Orbital Period
koi_period.desc: Time taken to complete one orbit around host star

koi_duration.name: Transit Duration
koi_duration.desc: Time host star appears dimmed during transit

koi_depth.name: Transit Depth
koi_depth.desc: Fraction of stellar brightness dimmed (parts per million)

koi_impact.name: Impact Parameter
koi_impact.desc: Sky-projected distance of transit chord from star center

koi_teq.name: Equilibrium Temp
koi_teq.desc: Estimated blackbody surface temperature of exoplanet

koi_insol.name: Insolation Flux
koi_insol.desc: Stellar radiation energy flux relative to Earth

koi_steff.name: Host Star Temp
koi_steff.desc: Effective surface temperature of the host star

koi_slogg.name: Host Star Surface Gravity
koi_slogg.desc: Surface gravity of host star in log scale

koi_srad.name: Host Star Radius
koi_srad.desc: Physical radius of host star relative to our Sun

koi_smass.name: Host Star Mass
koi_smass.desc: Physical mass of host star relative to our Sun (Regression Only)

koi_kepmag.name: Kepler Optical Magnitude
koi_kepmag.desc: Apparent optical brightness in Kepler photometric band

\ud83c\udf0d Earth 2.0 Candidate.desc: Earth-sized temperate candidate orbiting a G-type Sun-like star in habitable zone.

\ud83e\ude90 Kepler-452b (Confirmed Supe.desc: Known confirmed Super-Earth in habitable zone with ~1.6 Earth radii.

\ud83d\udd25 Hot Jupiter (Confirmed Gian.desc: Gas giant orbiting in extreme proximity with deep transit depth and intense stellar flux.

\u2b50 Eclipsing Binary (Astrophysical F.desc: Stellar binary eclipsing event characterized by huge transit depth and steep V-shaped ingress.
